activities.instructions: Desliza a la derecha si la frase es correcta y a la izquierda si no lo es.
activities.prompt: Mazo de 7 afirmaciones para repasar el tema.

cards.statement: Automation can reduce the time staff spend on repetitive tasks.
cards.explanation: Automating routine work can free people to handle less repetitive tasks.

cards.statement: The quality and coverage of a dataset can affect a model’s output.
cards.explanation: Unbalanced or incomplete data can influence learned patterns.

cards.statement: A model can be trained on labelled examples.
cards.explanation: Labelled examples help a model learn the patterns it should recognise.

cards.statement: A digital footprint is the trace left by someone’s online activity.
cards.explanation: Searches, accounts and posts can contribute to a digital footprint.

cards.statement: Facial recognition attempts to identify people from facial features.
cards.explanation: The technology compares facial features with stored or learned patterns.

cards.statement: A service can protect stored data well and still collect more personal information than necessary.
cards.explanation: Security and privacy address related but different questions.

cards.statement: An algorithm is a set of instructions for processing a task.
cards.explanation: Algorithms describe the steps a system follows.

activities.explanation: Cada carta repasa una regla del tema; revisa las falladas al terminar el mazo.

activities.instructions: Desliza a la derecha si la frase es correcta y a la izquierda si no lo es.
activities.prompt: Mazo de 8 afirmaciones para repasar el tema.

cards.statement: A chatbot is necessarily operated by a human who types every reply.
cards.explanation: A chatbot produces automated replies, although people may supervise it.

cards.statement: Privacy and security always mean exactly the same thing.
cards.explanation: Privacy concerns the use of personal information; security concerns protection from threats.

cards.statement: Encryption prevents authorised users from reading a file even when they have the correct key.
cards.explanation: A correct key allows an authorised user to decrypt the file.

cards.statement: A security patch is an update that can fix a software vulnerability.
cards.explanation: Patches commonly repair bugs or security weaknesses.

cards.statement: Bias can describe a systematic tendency that disadvantages a group.
cards.explanation: Bias is more than one accidental error; it is a recurring pattern.

cards.statement: One correct output proves that an automated system contains no bias.
cards.explanation: Bias is assessed across patterns and groups, not one result.

cards.statement: Data minimisation means collecting every possible detail in case it becomes useful.
cards.explanation: Data minimisation limits collection to information that is necessary.

cards.statement: A dataset can contain examples used to train a model.
cards.explanation: Training data is organised into a dataset.

activities.explanation: Cada carta repasa una regla del tema; revisa las falladas al terminar el mazo.

activities.instructions: Desliza a la derecha si la frase es correcta y a la izquierda si no lo es.
activities.prompt: Mazo de 5 afirmaciones para repasar el tema.

cards.statement: A transparent automated process can be examined by the people affected by it.
cards.explanation: Transparency makes a process or its reasoning easier to scrutinise.

cards.statement: Troubleshooting involves finding the cause of a technical problem.
cards.explanation: Troubleshooting is systematic fault-finding and repair.

cards.statement: To automate a task always means that no human oversight is possible.
cards.explanation: Automation can reduce routine input while people still supervise the process.

cards.statement: Human review can still be useful when an AI tool produces an answer.
cards.explanation: Review helps detect mistakes, uncertainty and unfair patterns.

cards.statement: A biased model must produce an incorrect result every single time.
cards.explanation: Bias can create systematic differences without making every individual output wrong.
